scenes.name: Zero Marsh
scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production restoration scene atlas for the children's game Times Quest. Create ONE square 3072x3072 image containing EXACTLY SIX edge-to-edge rectangular panels in a precise TWO COLUMN by THREE ROW grid. Every panel is landscape 3:2, equal size. Absolutely NO gutters, panel borders, text, labels, numbers, watermarks, characters or animals. The reference image is a palette, material and painterly world-style reference ONLY. Each panel must show the SAME camera, SAME setting, SAME landscape and SAME landmark footprint; only restoration state changes. High-quality richly painted storybook game art, tactile stone/wood details, warm nuanced lighting, inviting depth. Each panel: open level foreground terrace in LEFT third for an existing guardian sprite added later, landmark in RIGHT half with full silhouette inside panel, landscape behind, lower 18% quiet for UI caption. Landmark must be large and clear at phone size, never cut off. Panels read left-to-right, top-to-bottom: 1 neglected, 2 initial repairs, 3 near-complete, 4 restored, 5 celebration, 6 environment with landmark removed (empty right terrace). Panel six retains same setting and camera. No new unrelated structures in foreground.
Realm: Zero Marsh.
Setting: A gentle misty teal marsh with ancient willows, reeds and a winding stone causeway to a mossy arch on the right.
Five landmark states, in required panel order: The causeway and three bronze lantern posts: first hidden by low fog and overgrown, then bank cleared and first unlit post visible, then complete causeway visible with three unlit lanterns, then clear welcoming path and three warm lit lanterns, finally gold and teal festival ribbons on the posts.
Preserve the landmark's identity and surroundings across all five states. Sixth panel is the same empty environment.
